title: Game Jam: 48-hour indie game sprint
description: A weekend game jam to prototype a playable game from a mystery theme. Solo participants and teams are welcome; bring a laptop and an idea, and mentors will be available for art, code, and playtesting.
author: WDCC Game Dev Club

title: Game Art Bootcamp: sprites and animation
description: A practical workshop on creating game-ready art, including character sprites, tilesets, and simple walk-cycle animation in Aseprite. Beginners are welcome and all completed assets are yours to keep.
author: Pixel Garden Studio

title: Hackathon Kickoff: build a project in 24 hours
description: A 24-hour hackathon to build something useful or fun, from web apps and bots to hardware and art installations. Pitch on Saturday morning and demonstrate your project on Sunday night.
author: CHCH Hack Society

title: Build Night: turn your idea into a prototype
description: Bring an early-stage idea and work alongside student developers, designers, and makers. Volunteer mentors will help with scoping, technical decisions, and preparing a short end-of-night demo.
author: Campus Makers Collective

title: Portfolio Clinic: feedback from senior students
description: Get practical feedback on your portfolio, CV, or GitHub profile in a friendly small-group session. Reviewers from design, software, engineering, and business backgrounds will be available.
author: Student Careers Network

title: Creative Collaboration Mixer
description: Meet students looking for collaborators across art, design, technology, music, and entrepreneurship. Share what you can contribute, discover new project ideas, and form a team on the night.
author: Otago Creative Community
